basic_info.description: Welcome to this contemporary two bedrooms, one bathroom condominium, located in the lively Mission District of San Francisco. This  property offers a remodeled kitchen with brand new appliances- Stove with oven and new range hood and exhaust fan,refrigerator and diswasher and newly interior painting and newly installed blinds on all windows.Very accessible transportation- MUNI Bus - just walk to 16th ST.- BART Station> Walk to all shopping - boutique, night club,restaurant,church,school ,park and easy access to freeway 101 and 280. Price is so affordable than renting...Bring your Fussy Buyers to own a piece of property that is convenietly  located to all amenities.Seller is relocating to outside state.
